dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ……隣が寂しいな」
dialogues.en:
Kotori, Mako, and Moe-sempai will be cleaning up after the
party.
dialogues.text:
Kotori, Mako, and Moe-sempai will be cleaning up after the
party.

dialogues.jp: 卒業式。
dialogues.en: I wonder...... where Sakura is.
dialogues.text: I wonder...... where Sakura is.

dialogues.jp: 桜吹雪に包まれた道を帰る者の姿はない。
dialogues.en: "Sigh...... it's so lonely."
dialogues.text: "Sigh...... it's so lonely."

dialogues.jp:
背後の校舎では、卒業パーティーがまだ続いて
いた。
dialogues.en: "Don't worry. You have me."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry. You have me."

dialogues.jp:
音夢も美春も、風紀委員として今も校舎のどこ
かを見回っているはずだ。
dialogues.en: I turned around to see whose hand was on my shoulder.
dialogues.text: I turned around to see whose hand was on my shoulder.

dialogues.jp:
ことりや眞子、萌先輩などの参加組は、この後
も片付けがある。
さくらは……どこいったんだろう。

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「案ずるな。俺がいる」
ポンと肩に置かれた手の主を振り返る。

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Thank you. But no thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you. But no thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: I removed his hand from my shoulder.
dialogues.text: I removed his hand from my shoulder.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Okay. That's too bad."
dialogues.text: "Okay. That's too bad."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en:
"We'll see each other again at school even after
graduation."
dialogues.text:
"We'll see each other again at school even after
graduation."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ありがとう。ぜひとも、お断りさせていただ
　くよ」
dialogues.en: "I'd like to decline."
dialogues.text: "I'd like to decline."

dialogues.jp: さりげなく肩の手をどける。
dialogues.en: I smiled back at him sarcastically.
dialogues.text: I smiled back at him sarcastically.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうか。残念だ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm being nice to someone who's lonely on the day of
graduation. Don't be so mean."
dialogues.text:
"I'm being nice to someone who's lonely on the day of
graduation. Don't be so mean."

dialogues.jp: 爽やかに笑い返す。
dialogues.en: "Leave me alone."
dialogues.text: "Leave me alone."

dialogues.jp: 額を押さえて歩き出す。
dialogues.en: I put my hand on my forehead, and began walking.
dialogues.text: I put my hand on my forehead, and began walking.

dialogues.jp:
そう言えば、今日はカップルが多かった気もす
るな。
dialogues.en: I think there were a lot of couples today.
dialogues.text: I think there were a lot of couples today.

dialogues.jp:
俺も、もう少し女の子達と仲良くしていれば告
白とか、一緒に回って遊んだりも出来たのだろ
う。
dialogues.en:
If I made more effort to get along with the girls, maybe I
might have had someone asking me out or something.
dialogues.text:
If I made more effort to get along with the girls, maybe I
might have had someone asking me out or something.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほっといてもいいがな」
dialogues.en: "I could leave you alone."
dialogues.text: "I could leave you alone."

dialogues.jp:
ポンポン、と卒業証書のはいった筒で肩を叩い
て、杉並が隣に並ぶ。
dialogues.en:
He patted my shoulder with his diploma holder and walked
beside me.
dialogues.text:
He patted my shoulder with his diploma holder and walked
beside me.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「缶コーヒーでも飲みに行くか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want a cup of coffee?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want a cup of coffee?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……ピンポイントやなぁ」
dialogues.en: "......That got me."
dialogues.text: "......That got me."

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、まだまだ、男友達とこんなバカ騒ぎとか、
気の置けない関係で遊び歩いてもいいのだろう。
dialogues.en:
It might still be okay just to hang around with male friends
like this.
dialogues.text:
It might still be okay just to hang around with male friends
like this.

dialogues.jp: 何かが終わったけれど、また始まるのだ。
dialogues.en: Something ended, but something new will begin.
dialogues.text: Something ended, but something new will begin.

dialogues.jp: その時に希望を託して。
dialogues.en: I'll save my hopes for the 'something new'.
dialogues.text: I'll save my hopes for the 'something new'.

dialogues.jp: 今日は缶コーヒー。
dialogues.en: I guess a cup of coffee will do for now.
dialogues.text: I guess a cup of coffee will do for now.

dialogues.jp: ◆ＥＤ・友情も悪くない◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
ふう、無事卒業だなぁ。みな、卒パやら委員会
やらで未だに校舎に残っているはずだ。
dialogues.en: Graduation.
dialogues.text: Graduation.

dialogues.jp: ――ちょっと寂しい。
dialogues.en:
There were no other students on the street with the cherry
blossom petals billowing around.
dialogues.text:
There were no other students on the street with the cherry
blossom petals billowing around.

dialogues.jp:
と、杉並に肩を叩かれた。うん、まあ、まだこ
ういう友情関係も、悪くないな、と思った。
dialogues.en:
The graduation party was still continuing at the school
behind me.
dialogues.text:
The graduation party was still continuing at the school
behind me.

dialogues.jp: 明日からまた、馬鹿騒ぎをするかな。
dialogues.en:
Nemu and Miharu must still be patrolling as the students in
charge of discipline.
dialogues.text:
Nemu and Miharu must still be patrolling as the students in
charge of discipline.
